actual_task_instruction: I jotted down some songs in Simple Note recently. Make a playlist titled "Songs from Simple Note" out of it.

packet_source.instruction: I jotted down some songs in Simple Note recently. Make a playlist titled "Songs from Simple Note" out of it.

agents.actual_task_instruction: I jotted down some songs in Simple Note recently. Make a playlist titled "Songs from Simple Note" out of it.
released_registered_requirements: assert model changes match spotify.Playlist, spotify.PlaylistSong.

obtain added, updated, removed spotify.Playlist records using models.changed_records,
and assert 0 were updated or removed.
assert the playlist is titled public_data.playlist_title.
assert the song_ids in this added_playlist match the song_ids in data.private.song_ids (ignore order).
